investigation_notes.Description: An anomalous volume of SharePoint file downloads (750 files) was observed from the user targeting the Juhtkond_Ja_Finants site, markedly above the 24-hour baseline of 15. The downloaded items include multiple finance and payroll documents classified as sensitive, the activity occurred at 00:15 local time in Tallinn, and the account belongs to Customer Support which lacks an apparent business need for these files; no recent related events or similar alerts were found. Given the large volume, sensitive content, role-to-data mismatch, and after-hours access, this alert is High Priority because it could indicate insider misuse or an account compromise that requires escalation.
